Write a job description for a [job title] at my company, [company name]. We're a [describe your company — size, industry, vibe, stage]. This role will: [list 3-5 key responsibilities].
Structure: (1) An attention-grabbing intro (2-3 sentences) about why this role matters and who'd thrive in it — skip the "we're looking for a rockstar" nonsense, (2) What you'll do — 5-7 specific responsibilities written as outcomes, not tasks, (3) What you bring — required skills/experience (be real about what's actually needed vs. nice-to-have), (4) What we offer — [list: salary range, benefits, perks, remote/hybrid, growth opportunity], (5) How to apply — [application instructions]. Tone: [describe company culture — e.g., "direct, ambitious, no-BS" or "warm, collaborative, mission-driven"]. Make a great candidate think "this is the job I've been looking for."
